units.leftText: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, but his delight is in the LORD’s law.
units.rightText: Blessed is the man But his delight is in the Law of the LORD,

units.leftText: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, The wicked are not so,
units.rightText: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, Not so the wicked!

units.leftText: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, For the LORD knows the way of the righteous,
units.rightText: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, For the LORD guards the path of the righteous,

units.leftText: Why do the nations rage, The kings of the earth take a stand,
units.rightText: Why do the nations rage The kings of the earth take their stand

units.leftText: “Let’s break their bonds apart, He who sits in the heavens will laugh.
units.rightText: “Let us break Their chains The One enthroned in heaven laughs;

units.leftText: Then he will speak to them in his anger, “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
units.rightText: Then He rebukes them in His anger, “I have installed My King on Zion,

units.leftText: I will tell of the decree: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance,
units.rightText: I will proclaim the decree Ask Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance,

units.leftText: You shall break them with a rod of iron. Now therefore be wise, you kings.
units.rightText: You will break them with an iron scepter; Therefore be wise, O kings;

units.leftText: Serve the LORD with fear, Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way,
units.rightText: Serve the LORD with fear, Kiss the Son, lest He be angry

units.leftText: LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many there are who say of my soul,
units.rightText: A Psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom. Many say of me,

units.leftText: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, I cry to the LORD with my voice,
units.rightText: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, To the LORD I cry aloud,

units.leftText: I laid myself down and slept. I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people
units.rightText: I lie down and sleep; I will not fear the myriads

units.leftText: Arise, LORD! Salvation belongs to the LORD.
units.rightText: Arise, O LORD! Salvation belongs to the LORD;

units.leftText: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor?
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. How long, O men, will my honor be maligned?

units.leftText: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; Stand in awe, and don’t sin.
units.rightText: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself; Be angry, yet do not sin;

units.leftText: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Many say, “Who will show us any good?”
units.rightText: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous Many ask, “Who can show us the good?”

units.leftText: You have put gladness in my heart, In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep,
units.rightText: You have filled my heart with more joy I will lie down and sleep in peace,

units.leftText: Give ear to my words, LORD. Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God,
units.rightText: For the choirmaster, to be accompanied by flutes. A Psalm of David. Attend to the sound of my cry,

units.leftText: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness.
units.rightText: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; For You are not a God who delights in wickedness;

units.leftText: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You will destroy those who speak lies.
units.rightText: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You destroy those who tell lies;

units.leftText: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies.
units.rightText: But I will enter Your house Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness

units.leftText: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Hold them guilty, God.
units.rightText: For not a word they speak can be trusted; Declare them guilty, O God;

units.leftText: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. For you will bless the righteous.
units.rightText: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous;

units.leftText: LORD, don’t rebuke me in your anger, Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments, according to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail;

units.leftText: My soul is also in great anguish. Return, LORD. Deliver my soul,
units.rightText: My soul is deeply distressed. Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul;

units.leftText: For in death there is no memory of you. I am weary with my groaning.
units.rightText: For there is no mention of You in death; I am weary from groaning;

units.leftText: My eye wastes away because of grief. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity,
units.rightText: My eyes fail from grief; Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity,

units.leftText: The LORD has heard my supplication. May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed.
units.rightText: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed;

units.leftText: LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. lest they tear apart my soul like a lion,
units.rightText: A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the LORD concerning the words of Cush, a Benjamite. or they will shred my soul like a lion

units.leftText: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me
units.rightText: O LORD my God, if I have done this, if I have rewarded my ally with evil,

units.leftText: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; Arise, LORD, in your anger.
units.rightText: then may my enemy pursue me and overtake me; Arise, O LORD, in Your anger;

units.leftText: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. The LORD administers judgment to the peoples.
units.rightText: Let the assembled peoples gather around You; The LORD judges the peoples;

units.leftText: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, My shield is with God,
units.rightText: Put an end to the evil of the wicked, My shield is with God,

units.leftText: God is a righteous judge, If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword;
units.rightText: God is a righteous judge If one does not repent,

units.leftText: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. Behold, he travails with iniquity.
units.rightText: He has prepared His deadly weapons; Behold, the wicked man travails with evil;

units.leftText: He has dug a hole, The trouble he causes shall return to his own head.
units.rightText: He has dug a hole and hollowed it out; His trouble recoils on himself,

units.leftText: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength,
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David. From the mouths of children and infants

units.leftText: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, what is man, that you think of him?
units.rightText: When I behold Your heavens, what is man that You are mindful of him,

units.leftText: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, You make him ruler over the works of your hands.
units.rightText: You made him a little lower than the angels; You made him ruler of the works of Your hands;

units.leftText: All sheep and cattle, the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea,
units.rightText: all sheep and oxen, the birds of the air and the fish of the sea,

units.leftText: I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will be glad and rejoice in you.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm of David. I will be glad and rejoice in You;

units.leftText: When my enemies turn back, For you have maintained my just cause.
units.rightText: When my enemies retreat, For You have upheld my just cause;

units.leftText: You have rebuked the nations. The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin.
units.rightText: You have rebuked the nations; The enemy has come to eternal ruin,

units.leftText: But the LORD reigns forever. He will judge the world in righteousness.
units.rightText: But the LORD abides forever; He judges the world with justice;

units.leftText: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; Those who know your name will put their trust in you,
units.rightText: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, Those who know Your name trust in You,

units.leftText: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, For he who avenges blood remembers them.
units.rightText: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion; For the Avenger of bloodshed remembers;

units.leftText: Have mercy on me, LORD. that I may show all of your praise.
units.rightText: Be merciful to me, O LORD; that I may declare all Your praises —

units.leftText: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. The LORD has made himself known.
units.rightText: The nations have fallen into a pit of their making; The LORD is known by the justice He brings;

units.leftText: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, For the needy shall not always be forgotten,
units.rightText: The wicked will return to Sheol— For the needy will not always be forgotten;

units.leftText: Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Put them in fear, LORD.
units.rightText: Rise up, O LORD, do not let man prevail; Lay terror upon them, O LORD;

units.leftText: Why do you stand far off, LORD? In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak.
units.rightText: Why, O LORD, do You stand far off? In pride the wicked pursue the needy;

units.leftText: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. The wicked, in the pride of his face,
units.rightText: For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart; In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him;

units.leftText: His ways are prosperous at all times. He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken.
units.rightText: He is secure in his ways at all times; He says to himself, “I will not be moved;

units.leftText: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. He lies in wait near the villages.
units.rightText: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; He lies in wait near the villages;

units.leftText: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. The helpless are crushed.
units.rightText: He lies in wait like a lion in a thicket; They are crushed and beaten down;

units.leftText: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. Arise, LORD!
units.rightText: He says to himself, “God has forgotten; Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God!

units.leftText: Why does the wicked person condemn God, But you do see trouble and grief.
units.rightText: Why has the wicked man renounced God? But You have regarded trouble and grief;

units.leftText: Break the arm of the wicked. The LORD is King forever and ever!
units.rightText: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; The LORD is King forever and ever;

units.leftText: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. to judge the fatherless and the oppressed,
units.rightText: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; to vindicate the fatherless and oppressed,

units.leftText: In the LORD, I take refuge. For, behold, the wicked bend their bows.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. Of David. For behold, the wicked bend their bows.

units.leftText: If the foundations are destroyed, The LORD is in his holy temple.
units.rightText: If the foundations are destroyed, The LORD is in His holy temple;

units.leftText: The LORD examines the righteous, On the wicked he will rain blazing coals;
units.rightText: The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked; On the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur;

units.leftText: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. Everyone lies to his neighbor.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. According to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. They lie to one another;

units.leftText: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail.
units.rightText: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips They say, “With our tongues we will prevail.

units.leftText: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, The LORD’s words are flawless words,
units.rightText: “For the cause of the oppressed The words of the LORD are flawless,

units.leftText: You will keep them, LORD. The wicked walk on every side,
units.rightText: You, O LORD, will keep us; The wicked wander freely,

units.leftText: How long, LORD? How long shall I take counsel in my soul,
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. How long must I wrestle in my soul,

units.leftText: Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;”
units.rightText: Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. lest my enemy say, “I have overcome him,”

units.leftText: But I trust in your loving kindness. I will sing to the LORD,
units.rightText: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; I will sing to the LORD,

units.leftText: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men,
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. Of David. The LORD looks down from heaven

units.leftText: They have all gone aside. Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge,
units.rightText: All have turned away, Will the workers of iniquity never learn?

units.leftText: There they were in great fear, You frustrate the plan of the poor,
units.rightText: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, You sinners frustrate the plans of the oppressed,

units.leftText: LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? He who walks blamelessly and does what is right,
units.rightText: A Psalm of David. He who walks with integrity

units.leftText: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, in whose eyes a vile man is despised,
units.rightText: who has no slander on his tongue, who despises the vile

units.leftText: Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you. My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord.
units.rightText: A Miktam of David. I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord;

units.leftText: As for the saints who are on the earth, Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god.
units.rightText: As for the saints in the land, Sorrows will multiply

units.leftText: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places.
units.rightText: The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places;

units.leftText: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. I have set the LORD always before me.
units.rightText: I will bless the LORD who counsels me; I have set the LORD always before me.

units.leftText: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. For you will not leave my soul in Sheol,
units.rightText: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol,

units.leftText: Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Let my sentence come out of your presence.
units.rightText: A prayer of David. May my vindication come from Your presence;

units.leftText: You have proved my heart. As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips,
units.rightText: You have tried my heart; As for the deeds of men —

units.leftText: My steps have held fast to your paths. I have called on you, for you will answer me, God.
units.rightText: My steps have held to Your paths; I call on You, O God,

units.leftText: Show your marvelous loving kindness, Keep me as the apple of your eye.
units.rightText: Show the wonders of Your loving devotion, Keep me as the apple of Your eye;

units.leftText: from the wicked who oppress me, They close up their callous hearts.
units.rightText: from the wicked who assail me, They have closed their callous hearts;

units.leftText: They have now surrounded us in our steps. He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey,
units.rightText: They have tracked us down, and now surround us; like a lion greedy for prey,

units.leftText: Arise, LORD, confront him. from men by your hand, LORD,
units.rightText: Arise, O LORD, confront them! from such men, O LORD, by Your hand—

units.leftText: I love you, LORD, my strength. The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer;
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. Of David the servant of the LORD, who sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. He said: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.

units.leftText: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; The cords of death surrounded me.
units.rightText: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; The cords of death encompassed me;

units.leftText: The cords of Sheol were around me. In my distress I called on the LORD,
units.rightText: The cords of Sheol entangled me; In my distress I called upon the LORD;

units.leftText: Then the earth shook and trembled. Smoke went out of his nostrils.
units.rightText: Then the earth shook and quaked, Smoke rose from His nostrils,

units.leftText: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. He rode on a cherub, and flew.
units.rightText: He parted the heavens and came down He mounted a cherub and flew;

units.leftText: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed,
units.rightText: He made darkness His hiding place, From the brightness of His presence

units.leftText: The LORD also thundered in the sky. He sent out his arrows, and scattered them.
units.rightText: The LORD thundered from heaven; He shot His arrows and scattered the foes;

units.leftText: Then the channels of waters appeared. He sent from on high.
units.rightText: The channels of the sea appeared, He reached down from on high and took hold of me;

units.leftText: He delivered me from my strong enemy, They came on me in the day of my calamity,
units.rightText: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, They confronted me in my day of calamity,

units.leftText: He brought me out also into a large place. The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness.
units.rightText: He brought me out into the open; The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness;

units.leftText: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, For all his ordinances were before me.
units.rightText: For I have kept the ways of the LORD For all His ordinances are before me;

units.leftText: I was also blameless with him. Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness,
units.rightText: And I have been blameless before Him So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness,

units.leftText: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the pure, you will show yourself pure.
units.rightText: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the pure You show Yourself pure,

units.leftText: For you will save the afflicted people, For you will light my lamp, LORD.
units.rightText: For You save an afflicted people, For You, O LORD, light my lamp;

units.leftText: For by you, I advance through a troop. As for God, his way is perfect.
units.rightText: For in You I can charge an army, As for God, His way is perfect;

units.leftText: For who is God, except the LORD? the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
units.rightText: For who is God besides the LORD? It is God who arms me with strength

units.leftText: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, He teaches my hands to war,
units.rightText: He makes my feet like those of a deer He trains my hands for battle;

units.leftText: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. You have enlarged my steps under me,
units.rightText: You have given me Your shield of salvation; You broaden the path beneath me

units.leftText: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise.
units.rightText: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I crushed them so they could not rise;

units.leftText: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me,
units.rightText: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have made my enemies retreat before me;

units.leftText: They cried, but there was no one to save; Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind.
units.rightText: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them — I ground them as dust in the face of the wind;

units.leftText: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me.
units.rightText: You have delivered me from the strife of the people; When they hear me, they obey me;

units.leftText: The foreigners shall fade away, The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock.
units.rightText: Foreigners lose heart The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock!

units.leftText: even the God who executes vengeance for me, He rescues me from my enemies.
units.rightText: the God who avenges me who delivers me from my enemies.

units.leftText: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, He gives great deliverance to his king,
units.rightText: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; Great salvation He brings to His king.

units.leftText: The heavens declare the glory of God. Day after day they pour out speech,
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Day after day they pour forth speech;

units.leftText: There is no speech nor language Their voice has gone out through all the earth,
units.rightText: Without speech or language, their voice has gone out into all the earth,

units.leftText: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, His going out is from the end of the heavens,
units.rightText: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, it rises at one end of the heavens

units.leftText: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart.
units.rightText: The Law of the LORD is perfect, The precepts of the LORD are right,

units.leftText: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold,
units.rightText: The fear of the LORD is pure, They are more precious than gold,

units.leftText: Moreover your servant is warned by them. Who can discern his errors?
units.rightText: By them indeed Your servant is warned; Who can discern his own errors?

units.leftText: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart
units.rightText: Keep Your servant also from willful sins; May the words of my mouth

units.leftText: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. send you help from the sanctuary,
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. May He send you help from the sanctuary

units.leftText: remember all your offerings, May he grant you your heart’s desire,
units.rightText: May He remember all your gifts May He give you the desires of your heart

units.leftText: We will triumph in your salvation. Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed.
units.rightText: May we shout for joy at your victory Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed;

units.leftText: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, They are bowed down and fallen,
units.rightText: Some trust in chariots and others in horses, They collapse and fall,

units.leftText: The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! You have given him his heart’s desire,
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. You have granted his heart’s desire

units.leftText: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. He asked life of you and you gave it to him,
units.rightText: For You welcomed him with rich blessings; He asked You for life, and You granted it—

units.leftText: His glory is great in your salvation. For you make him most blessed forever.
units.rightText: Great is his glory in Your salvation; For You grant him blessings forever;

units.leftText: For the king trusts in the LORD. Your hand will find out all of your enemies.
units.rightText: For the king trusts in the LORD; Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies;

units.leftText: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. You will destroy their descendants from the earth,
units.rightText: You will place them in a fiery furnace You will wipe their descendants from the earth,

units.leftText: For they intended evil against you. For you will make them turn their back,
units.rightText: Though they intend You harm, For You will put them to flight

units.leftText: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer;
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Doe of the Dawn.” A Psalm of David. I cry out by day, O my God,

units.leftText: But you are holy, Our fathers trusted in you.
units.rightText: Yet You are holy, In You our fathers trusted;

units.leftText: They cried to you, and were delivered. But I am a worm, and no man;
units.rightText: They cried out to You and were set free; But I am a worm and not a man,

units.leftText: All those who see me mock me. “He trusts in the LORD.
units.rightText: All who see me mock me; “He trusts in the LORD,

units.leftText: But you brought me out of the womb. I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb.
units.rightText: Yet You brought me forth from the womb; From birth I was cast upon You;

units.leftText: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. Many bulls have surrounded me.
units.rightText: Be not far from me, Many bulls surround me;

units.leftText: They open their mouths wide against me, I am poured out like water.
units.rightText: They open their jaws against me I am poured out like water,

units.leftText: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. For dogs have surrounded me.
units.rightText: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, For dogs surround me;

units.leftText: I can count all of my bones. They divide my garments among them.
units.rightText: I can count all my bones; They divide my garments among them

units.leftText: But don’t be far off, LORD. Deliver my soul from the sword,
units.rightText: But You, O LORD, be not far off; Deliver my soul from the sword,

units.leftText: Save me from the lion’s mouth! I will declare your name to my brothers.
units.rightText: Save me from the mouth of the lion; I will proclaim Your name to my brothers;

units.leftText: You who fear the LORD, praise him! For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted,
units.rightText: You who fear the LORD, praise Him! For He has not despised or detested

units.leftText: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. The humble shall eat and be satisfied.
units.rightText: My praise for You resounds in the great assembly; The poor will eat and be satisfied;

units.leftText: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. For the kingdom is the LORD’s.
units.rightText: All the ends of the earth For dominion belongs to the LORD

units.leftText: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. Posterity shall serve him.
units.rightText: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; Posterity will serve Him;

units.leftText: The LORD is my shepherd; He makes me lie down in green pastures.
units.rightText: A Psalm of David. He makes me lie down in green pastures;

units.leftText: He restores my soul. Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,
units.rightText: He restores my soul; Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,

units.leftText: You prepare a table before me Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life,
units.rightText: You prepare a table before me Surely goodness and mercy will follow me

units.leftText: The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; For he has founded it on the seas,
units.rightText: A Psalm of David. For He has founded it upon the seas

units.leftText: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? He who has clean hands and a pure heart;
units.rightText: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? He who has clean hands and a pure heart,

units.leftText: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, This is the generation of those who seek Him,
units.rightText: He will receive blessing from the LORD Such is the generation of those who seek Him,

units.leftText: Lift up your heads, you gates! Who is the King of glory?
units.rightText: Lift up your heads, O gates! Who is this King of Glory?

units.leftText: Lift up your heads, you gates; Who is this King of glory?
units.rightText: Lift up your heads, O gates! Who is He, this King of Glory?

units.leftText: To you, LORD, I lift up my soul. My God, I have trusted in you.
units.rightText: Of David. in You, my God, I trust.

units.leftText: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. Show me your ways, LORD.
units.rightText: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; Show me Your ways, O LORD;

units.leftText: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness,
units.rightText: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion,

units.leftText: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Good and upright is the LORD,

units.rightText: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept There on the willows

units.leftText: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?
units.rightText: for there our captors requested a song; How can we sing a song of the LORD

units.leftText: If I forget you, Jerusalem, Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you,
units.rightText: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth

units.leftText: Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction,
units.rightText: Remember, O LORD, O Daughter of Babylon,

units.leftText: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. I will bow down toward your holy temple,
units.rightText: Of David. I bow down toward Your holy temple

units.leftText: In the day that I called, you answered me. All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD,
units.rightText: On the day I called, You answered me; All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD,

units.leftText: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly;
units.rightText: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, Though the LORD is on high,

units.leftText: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me.
units.rightText: If I walk in the midst of trouble, The LORD will fulfill

units.leftText: LORD, you have searched me, You know my sitting down and my rising up.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. You know when I sit and when I rise;

units.leftText: You search out my path and my lying down, For there is not a word on my tongue,
units.rightText: You search out my path and my lying down; Even before a word is on my tongue,

units.leftText: You hem me in behind and before. This knowledge is beyond me.
units.rightText: You hem me in behind and before; Such knowledge is too wonderful for me,

units.leftText: Where could I go from your Spirit? If I ascend up into heaven, you are there.
units.rightText: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? If I ascend to the heavens, You are there;

units.leftText: If I take the wings of the dawn, even there your hand will lead me,
units.rightText: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, even there Your hand will guide me;

units.leftText: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. even the darkness doesn’t hide from you,
units.rightText: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, even the darkness is not dark to You,

units.leftText: For you formed my inmost being. I will give thanks to you,
units.rightText: For You formed my inmost being; I praise You,

units.leftText: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, Your eyes saw my body.
units.rightText: My frame was not hidden from You Your eyes saw my unformed body;

units.leftText: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand.
units.rightText: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, If I were to count them,

units.leftText: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. For they speak against you wickedly.
units.rightText: O God, that You would slay the wicked— who speak of You deceitfully;

units.leftText: LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? I hate them with perfect hatred.
units.rightText: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, I hate them with perfect hatred;

units.leftText: Search me, God, and know my heart. See if there is any wicked way in me,
units.rightText: Search me, O God, and know my heart; See if there is any offensive way in me;

units.leftText: Deliver me, LORD, from evil men. those who devise mischief in their hearts.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. who devise evil in their hearts

units.leftText: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked.
units.rightText: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; Guard me, O LORD,

units.leftText: The proud have hidden a snare for me, I said to the LORD, “You are my God.”
units.rightText: The proud hide a snare for me; I say to the LORD, “You are my God.”

units.leftText: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked.
units.rightText: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked;

units.leftText: As for the head of those who surround me, Let burning coals fall on them.
units.rightText: May the heads of those who surround me May burning coals fall on them;

units.leftText: An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted,
units.rightText: May no slanderer be established in the land; I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor

units.leftText: LORD, I have called on you. Let my prayer be set before you like incense;
units.rightText: A Psalm of David. May my prayer be set before You like incense;

units.leftText: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing,
units.rightText: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing

units.leftText: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock.
units.rightText: Let the righteous man strike me; When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs,

units.leftText: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord.
units.rightText: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, But my eyes are fixed on You,

units.leftText: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, Let the wicked fall together into their own nets
units.rightText: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, Let the wicked fall into their own nets,

units.leftText: I cry with my voice to the LORD. I pour out my complaint before him.
units.rightText: A Maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer. I pour out my complaint before Him;

units.leftText: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, Look on my right, and see;
units.rightText: Although my spirit grows faint within me, Look to my right and see;

units.leftText: I cried to you, LORD. Listen to my cry,
units.rightText: I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, Listen to my cry,

units.leftText: Hear my prayer, LORD. Don’t enter into judgment with your servant,
units.rightText: A Psalm of David. Do not bring Your servant into judgment,

units.leftText: For the enemy pursues my soul. Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me.
units.rightText: For the enemy has pursued my soul, My spirit grows faint within me;

units.leftText: I remember the days of old. I spread out my hands to you.
units.rightText: I remember the days of old; I stretch out my hands to You;

units.leftText: Hurry to answer me, LORD. Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning,
units.rightText: Answer me quickly, O LORD; Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning,

units.leftText: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. Teach me to do your will,
units.rightText: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; Teach me to do Your will,

units.leftText: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake. In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies,
units.rightText: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, And in Your loving devotion,

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD, my rock, my loving kindness, my fortress,
units.rightText: Of David. He is my steadfast love and my fortress,

units.leftText: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Man is like a breath.
units.rightText: O LORD, what is man, that You regard him, Man is like a breath;

units.leftText: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Throw out lightning, and scatter them.
units.rightText: Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; Flash forth Your lightning and scatter them;

units.leftText: Stretch out your hand from above, whose mouths speak deceit,
units.rightText: Reach down from on high; whose mouths speak falsehood,

units.leftText: I will sing a new song to you, God. You are he who gives salvation to kings,
units.rightText: I will sing to You a new song, O God; to Him who gives victory to kings,

units.leftText: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants,
units.rightText: Set me free and rescue me Then our sons will be like plants

units.leftText: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our oxen will pull heavy loads.
units.rightText: Our storehouses will be full, Our oxen will bear great loads.

units.leftText: I will exalt you, my God, the King. Every day I will praise you.
units.rightText: A Psalm of praise. Of David. Every day I will bless You,

units.leftText: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! One generation will commend your works to another,
units.rightText: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; One generation will commend Your works to the next,

units.leftText: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts.
units.rightText: the glorious splendor of Your majesty. They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds,

units.leftText: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, The LORD is gracious, merciful,
units.rightText: They will extol the fame of Your abundant goodness The LORD is gracious and compassionate,

units.leftText: The LORD is good to all. All your works will give thanks to you, LORD.
units.rightText: The LORD is good to all; All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD,

units.leftText: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts,
units.rightText: They will tell of the glory of Your kingdom to make known to men Your mighty acts

units.leftText: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. The LORD upholds all who fall,
units.rightText: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, The LORD upholds all who fall

units.leftText: The eyes of all wait for you. You open your hand,
units.rightText: The eyes of all look to You, You open Your hand

units.leftText: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, The LORD is near to all those who call on him,
units.rightText: The LORD is righteous in all His ways The LORD is near to all who call on Him,

units.leftText: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. The LORD preserves all those who love him,
units.rightText: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; The LORD preserves all who love Him,

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! While I live, I will praise the LORD.
units.rightText: Hallelujah! I will praise the LORD all my life;

units.leftText: Don’t put your trust in princes, His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth.
units.rightText: Put not your trust in princes, When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground;

units.leftText: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, who made heaven and earth,
units.rightText: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, the Maker of heaven and earth,

units.leftText: who executes justice for the oppressed; The LORD opens the eyes of the blind.
units.rightText: He executes justice for the oppressed the LORD opens the eyes of the blind,

units.leftText: The LORD preserves the foreigners. The LORD will reign forever;
units.rightText: The LORD protects foreigners; The LORD reigns forever,

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, The LORD builds up Jerusalem.
units.rightText: Hallelujah! The LORD builds up Jerusalem;

units.leftText: He heals the broken in heart, He counts the number of the stars.
units.rightText: He heals the brokenhearted He determines the number of the stars;

units.leftText: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. The LORD upholds the humble.
units.rightText: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; The LORD sustains the humble,

units.leftText: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. who covers the sky with clouds,
units.rightText: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; who covers the sky with clouds,

units.leftText: He provides food for the livestock, He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse.
units.rightText: He provides food for the animals, He does not delight in the strength of the horse;

units.leftText: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, Praise the LORD, Jerusalem!
units.rightText: The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, Exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem;

units.leftText: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He makes peace in your borders.
units.rightText: For He strengthens the bars of your gates He makes peace at your borders;

units.leftText: He sends out his commandment to the earth. He gives snow like wool,
units.rightText: He sends forth His command to the earth; He spreads the snow like wool;

units.leftText: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. He sends out his word, and melts them.
units.rightText: He casts forth His hail like pebbles. He sends forth His word and melts them;

units.leftText: He shows his word to Jacob, He has not done this for just any nation.
units.rightText: He declares His word to Jacob, He has done this for no other nation;

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! Praise him, all his angels!
units.rightText: Hallelujah! Praise Him, all His angels;

units.leftText: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, you heavens of heavens,
units.rightText: Praise Him, O sun and moon; Praise Him, O highest heavens,

units.leftText: Let them praise the LORD’s name, He has also established them forever and ever.
units.rightText: Let them praise the name of the LORD, He established them forever and ever;

units.leftText: Praise the LORD from the earth, lightning and hail, snow and clouds,
units.rightText: Praise the LORD from the earth, lightning and hail, snow and clouds,

units.leftText: mountains and all hills, wild animals and all livestock,
units.rightText: mountains and all hills, wild animals and all cattle,

units.leftText: kings of the earth and all peoples, both young men and maidens,
units.rightText: kings of the earth and all peoples, young men and maidens,

units.leftText: Let them praise the LORD’s name, He has lifted up the horn of his people,
units.rightText: Let them praise the name of the LORD, He has raised up a horn for His people,

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! Let Israel rejoice in him who made them.
units.rightText: Hallelujah! Let Israel rejoice in their Maker;

units.leftText: Let them praise his name in the dance! For the LORD takes pleasure in his people.
units.rightText: Let them praise His name with dancing, For the LORD takes pleasure in His people;

units.leftText: Let the saints rejoice in honor. May the high praises of God be in their mouths,
units.rightText: Let the saints exult in glory; May the high praises of God be in their mouths,

units.leftText: to execute vengeance on the nations, to bind their kings with chains,
units.rightText: to inflict vengeance on the nations to bind their kings with chains

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! Praise him for his mighty acts!
units.rightText: Hallelujah! Praise Him for His mighty acts;

units.leftText: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with tambourine and dancing!
units.rightText: Praise Him with the sound of the horn; Praise Him with tambourine and dancing;

units.leftText: Praise him with loud cymbals! Let everything that has breath praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Praise Him with clashing cymbals; Let everything that has breath praise the LORD!
